description: This file defines a class for injecting controlled Azure Storage exceptions for testing purposes, along with a custom exception class that extends RequestFailedException. It includes methods to simulate exceptions before and after storage operations, and tracks invocation counts.

classes.name: SimpleAzureStorageExceptionInjector
classes.description: A class that injects exceptions before and after storage operations for testing fault tolerance.

classes.name: SimpleAzureStorageException
classes.description: A custom exception class extending RequestFailedException to represent Azure Storage errors.

methods.name: AfterStore
methods.description: Injects an exception after a storage operation if configured to do so.

methods.name: BeforeStore
methods.description: Injects an exception before a storage operation if configured to do so.

methods.name: SimpleAzureStorageException (constructors)
methods.description: Various constructors for creating instances of the custom exception with different parameters.
